panels.description: Shows request throughput over time, broken down by user type (partner, passenger, unknown), helping identify traffic patterns and spikes across different user categories.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL ${interval} ${bucket}) as time_bucket,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN JSONExtractRaw(request.headers, 'x-app-user-type') = '"partner"' THEN 1 END) as `partner`,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN JSONExtractRaw(request.headers, 'x-app-user-type') = '"passenger"' THEN 1 END) as `passenger`,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN JSONExtractRaw(request.headers, 'x-app-user-type') NOT IN ('"passenger"','"partner"') THEN 1 END) as `unknown`,
    COUNT(*) as total,
    1000 as `1k Line`,
    1000000 as `1m Line`
FROM kong
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) ${query0}
GROUP BY time_bucket
ORDER BY time_bucket DESC;

panels.title: Throughput

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT If(
    JSONExtractRaw(request.headers, 'x-app-user-type') = '"partner"',
    JSONExtractString(request.headers, 'x-app-user-id'),
    NULL
  )) AS `Partners`,
  COUNT(DISTINCT If(
    JSONExtractRaw(request.headers, 'x-app-user-type') = '"passenger"',
    JSONExtractString(request.headers, 'x-app-user-id'),
    NULL
  )) AS `Passengers`,
  COUNT(DISTINCT If(
    JSONExtractRaw(request.headers, 'x-app-user-type') NOT IN ('"partner"', '"passenger"'),
    JSONExtractString(request.headers, 'x-app-user-id'),
    NULL
  )) AS `Uknown Users`,
  COUNT(DISTINCT
    JSONExtractString(request.headers, 'x-app-user-id')
  ) AS `Max`
FROM kong
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) ${query0}

SELECT
    toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL ${interval} ${bucket}) as time_bucket,
    max(latencies.proxy) as "max proxy",
    min(latencies.proxy) as "min proxy",
    avg(latencies.proxy) as "avg proxy",
    max(latencies.kong) as "max internal",
    min(latencies.kong) as "min internal",
    avg(latencies.kong) as "avg internal",
    max(latencies.receive) as "max receive",
    min(latencies.receive) as "min recieve",
    avg(latencies.receive) as "avg recieve",
    max(latencies.request) as "max request",
    min(latencies.request) as "min request",
    avg(latencies.request) as "avg request",
    500 as `500ms Line`,
    1000 as `1s Line`,
    10000 as `10s Line`,
    60000 as `1m Line`
FROM kong
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) ${query0}
GROUP BY time_bucket
ORDER BY time_bucket DESC;

SELECT
    toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL ${interval} ${bucket}) as time_bucket,
    max(response.size) as `max response`,
    min(response.size) as `min response`,
    avg(response.size) as `avg response`,
    max(request.size) as `max request`,
    min(request.size) as `min request`,
    avg(request.size) as `avg request`,
    1024 as `1Kb line`,
    10240 as `10Kb line`,
    1048576 as `1Mb line`,
    10485760 as `10Mb line`
FROM kong
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) ${query0}
GROUP BY time_bucket
ORDER BY time_bucket DESC;

WITH user_agents AS (
    SELECT 
        timestamp,
        toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL ${interval} ${bucket}) as time_bucket,
        JSONExtractRaw(request.headers, 'user-agent') as ua
    FROM kong
    WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) ${query0}
),
classified_data AS (SELECT 
    time_bucket as time,
    CASE 
        WHEN match(ua, 'BYKEA.*iOS|CFNetwork.*Darwin|iPhone') THEN 'IOS'
        WHEN match(ua, 'Dalvik.*|okhttp.*') THEN 'ANDROID'
        WHEN match(ua, 'Mozilla\/') THEN 'BROWSER'
        ELSE 'OTHERS/TOOLS'
    END as category,
    -- OS Version extraction
    CASE 
        -- iOS patterns
        WHEN match(ua, 'BYKEA/[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+ \(.+?iOS .+?\) .+') 
            THEN extractAll(ua, '(iOS .+)?\)')[1]
        WHEN match(ua, '.*?/[0-9]+ CFNetwork.*? Darwin.*?') 
            THEN extractAll(ua, '(Darwin.+?)"')[1]
        WHEN match(ua, 'BYKEA/[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+ \(iPhone')
            THEN extractAll(ua, '(iOS .+?);')[1]
        -- Android patterns
        WHEN match(ua, 'Dalvik/.*? \(.*\)"') 
            THEN extractAll(ua, '(Android [0-9.]+?);')[1]
        -- Browser pattern
        WHEN match(ua, 'Mozilla\/') 
            THEN extractAll(ua, 'Mozilla\/.*?(\(.*?\))')[1]
        ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
    END as OS_VERSION,
    -- HTTP Client extraction
    CASE 
        -- iOS patterns
        WHEN match(ua, 'BYKEA/[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+ \(.+?iOS .+?\) .+') 
            THEN extractAll(ua, '\)(.+?)"')[1]
        WHEN match(ua, '.*?/[0-9]+ CFNetwork.*? Darwin.*?') 
            THEN extractAll(ua, '(CFNetwork.+?) ')[1]
        -- Android patterns
        WHEN match(ua, 'okhttp\/([0-9.]+)') 
            THEN extractAll(ua, 'okhttp\/([0-9.]+)')[1]
        -- Browser pattern
        WHEN match(ua, 'Mozilla\/') 
            THEN extractAll(ua, '(Mozilla\/.+?)\(')[1]
        ELSE '-'
    END as HTTP_CLIENT,
    CASE 
        -- iOS patterns
        WHEN match(ua, 'BYKEA/[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+ \(.+?iOS .+?\) .+') THEN 'IPhone'
        WHEN match(ua, '.*?/[0-9]+ CFNetwork.*? Darwin.*?') THEN 'Apple'
        WHEN match(ua, 'BYKEA/[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+ \(iPhone') THEN 'IPhone'
        -- Android patterns
        WHEN match(ua, 'Dalvik/.*? \(.*\)"') 
            THEN extractAll(ua, 'Android [0-9.]+?;(.*)(Build)|(MIUI)\/')[1]
        WHEN match(ua, 'okhttp\/([0-9.]+)') THEN 'GENERIC'
        -- Browser pattern
        WHEN match(ua, 'Mozilla\/') THEN 'GENERIC'
        ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
    END as DEVICE,
    ua as possible_values
FROM user_agents)

SELECT category,count(category) FROM (SELECT * FROM classified_data) GROUP BY category;

WITH ranked_values AS (
  SELECT
    request.path as possible_values
  FROM kong
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) ${query0}
  GROUP BY possible_values
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
  LIMIT 20
),
time_series_data AS (
  SELECT 
    toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL ${interval} ${bucket}) as time_bucket,
    request.path as app_version,
    COUNT(*) as request_count
  FROM kong
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) ${query0}
  GROUP BY time_bucket, app_version
  ORDER BY request_count ASC
)
SELECT 
  time_bucket,
  request_count as " ",
  CASE 
    WHEN app_version IN (SELECT possible_values FROM ranked_values) 
    THEN app_version 
    ELSE 'OTHER' 
  END as possible_values
FROM time_series_data
ORDER BY time_bucket ASC, request_count ASC

WITH ranked_values AS (
  SELECT
    JSONExtractRaw(request.headers, 'x-app-version') as possible_values
  FROM kong
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) ${query0}
  GROUP BY possible_values
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
  LIMIT 25
),
time_series_data AS (
  SELECT 
    toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL ${interval} ${bucket}) as time_bucket,
    JSONExtractRaw(request.headers, 'x-app-version') as app_version,
    COUNT(*) as request_count
  FROM kong
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) ${query0}
  GROUP BY time_bucket, app_version
)
SELECT 
  time_bucket,
  request_count as " ",
  CASE 
    WHEN app_version IN (SELECT possible_values FROM ranked_values) 
    THEN app_version 
    ELSE 'OTHER' 
  END as possible_values
FROM time_series_data
ORDER BY time_bucket ASC, request_count DESC

SELECT
    toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL ${interval} ${bucket}) as time_bucket,
    max(diffstamp)/1000 as max_value_seconds,
    min(diffstamp)/1000 as min_value_seconds,
    avg(diffstamp)/1000 as avg_value_seconds,
    10 as `10 Second Line`,
    60 as `1 Minute Line`,
    3600 as `1 Hour Line`
FROM kong
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) ${query0}
GROUP BY time_bucket
ORDER BY time_bucket DESC;

WITH ranked_values AS (
  SELECT
    DISTINCT response.status as possible_values,
    count(response.status) as rank_order
  FROM
    kong
  WHERE
    $__timeFilter(timestamp) ${query0}
  GROUP BY
    response.status
  ORDER BY
    rank_order DESC
  LIMIT
    20
),
ranked_accumulation AS (
  SELECT 
      toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL ${interval} ${bucket}) as time_bucket,
      toString(response.status) as possible_values,
      COUNT(response.status) as rank_order
  FROM
      kong
  WHERE
      $__timeFilter(timestamp) ${query0} AND
      response.status IN (SELECT possible_values FROM ranked_values)
  GROUP BY
      response.status,
      time_bucket
),
other_accumulation AS (
  SELECT 
      toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL ${interval} ${bucket}) as time_bucket,
      'OTHER' as possible_values,
      COUNT(response.status) as rank_order
  FROM
      kong
  WHERE
      $__timeFilter(timestamp) ${query0} AND
      response.status NOT IN (SELECT possible_values FROM ranked_values)
  GROUP BY
      time_bucket
),
accumulated_results AS ( SELECT * FROM other_accumulation UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ranked_accumulation)
SELECT time_bucket,rank_order as " ",possible_values FROM accumulated_results ORDER BY time_bucket ASC, rank_order DESC

WITH ranked_values AS (
  SELECT
    DISTINCT response.upstream as possible_values,
    count(response.upstream) as rank_order
  FROM
    kong
  WHERE
    $__timeFilter(timestamp) ${query0}
  GROUP BY

  ORDER BY

  LIMIT
    20
),
ranked_accumulation AS (

  FROM

  WHERE
      $__timeFilter(timestamp) ${query0} AND
      response.upstream IN (SELECT possible_values FROM ranked_values)
  GROUP BY

other_accumulation AS (

      'OTHER' as possible_values,

  FROM

  WHERE
      $__timeFilter(timestamp) ${query0} AND
      response.upstream NOT IN (SELECT possible_values FROM ranked_values)

accumulated_results AS ( SELECT * FROM other_accumulation UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ranked_accumulation)
SELECT time_bucket,rank_order as " ",possible_values FROM accumulated_results ORDER BY time_bucket ASC, rank_order DESC
